QuestInfo.name: Hatch the egg
QuestInfo.0: There are things to be done in order to tend Lazy Daisy's egg successfully. Let's go see the GM.
QuestInfo.1: You must go find the GM every day from Monday through Friday, and receive the growth powder and apply it on the egg.
QuestInfo.2: You receive the growth power for today. Hurry up and apply it on your chicken.

0.0: Hello, you must be taking care of Lazy Daisy's egg. Of course it's simply not enough to simply hunt and spread your energy.
0.1: You need one more thing. You have to apply this growth powder on your egg once a day... every day from Monday through Friday.
0.2: Tending an egg is not that easy, huh? Would you like to receive the growth power now?

yes.0: Yes, you have to devote yourself to the egg. Oh, wait... can you come back? Hmm, where did I put the growth powder...

no.0: Hmm, you might need this growth powder. I guess you can do without.

1.0: Found it! Here it is. Please take this and apply it to your egg with love and care.

yes.0: You have to apply it once a day. The effect will wear out after one day. Don't forget.
yes.1: If you come back tomorrow, I'll give you the growth powder.
